The S9510-28DC had the same silence and two real SKUs existed anyway (supplied by Jason), so this is a statement about the two documents held, not a claim that no SKU exists.","reason":"vendor-silent","scope":["dc-front-to-back","ac-front-to-back","dc-back-to-front","ac-back-to-front"],"wanted":"a UfiSpace ordering guide or a quote naming the chassis SKUs","what":"chassis-part-numbers"},{"note":"No underside photograph or figure exists in the intake; the bottom carries only an estimated compliance sticker.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["bottom"],"wanted":"a photograph of the underside on a bench","what":"bottom-face"},{"note":"HIG Figure 13 shows the sides only as isometric bracket-position art; rivet rows and bracket hole clusters are drawn at estimated positions, and the yellow grounding-label location on the left face is estimated from Figure 23.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["left","right"],"wanted":"a straight-on side photograph or a mechanical drawing","what":"side-face-detail"}],"groups":{"fans":{"description":"vendor numbers them FAN 0-4 on the rear silkscreen","index-origin":0,"role":"service","term":"Fan"},"furniture":{"index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Item"},"grounding":{"index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Point"},"mgmt":{"index-origin":1,"mixed":"the management block at the left-hand end of the faceplate - the out-of-band RJ45, a USB 3.0 Type-A service port and the RS-232 console, plus the recessed reset button. Same cluster, and the same word for it, as the other devices in the library that have one","role":"management","term":"Port"},"port-leds":{"description":"every indicator that belongs to a particular port, ordered by that port","index-origin":1,"role":"indicator","term":"LED"},"psus":{"description":"vendor numbers them PSU0 and PSU1 on the faceplate","index-origin":0,"role":"service","term":"PSU"},"qsfp28":{"attrs":{"media":"qsfp28","speed":"100g"},"index-origin":0,"role":"traffic","term":"Port"},"sfp-plus":{"attrs":{"media":"sfp-plus","speed":"10g"},"index-origin":0,"role":"traffic","term":"Port"},"status-leds":{"description":"the front-panel unit indicators - SYS, FAN, PS0, PS1 and the ID beacon","index-origin":1,"role":"indicator","term":"LED"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"UfiSpace","maturity":"modelled","model":"S7801-54XS","name":"s7801-54xs","portfolio":{"family":"Ethernet Switch","line":"Data Center"},"profile":"networking","provenance":{"attrs":"datasheet (Key Features, Specifications, Environmental, Performance, Regulatory Compliance and Accessories sections). Compliance strings are transcribed as printed, not tidied. The '80 km maximum support distance' rows of the HIG port table describe optic reach, not the switch, and are not device attrs.","bottom":"no photograph or figure of the underside exists in the intake. The face is sized from the datasheet and carries only the compliance/serial sticker that every unit of this class has, position and size estimated (common/compliance-sticker). See gaps.","chassis":"datasheet - 440 x 440 x 43.8 mm (W x D x H), 1RU, 8.9 kg without FRUs. The HIG component table repeats the same triple. The 440 body is the metal between the bolt-on rack brackets (HIG: \"shipped with a rack mount brackets suitable for 19 inch racks\", brackets are accessory items 2/3), so no ear subtraction applies; ears are not drawn per house rule.","eol":"searched 2026-08-28, \"UfiSpace S7801-54XS end of life\" - no announcement found; the product remains listed on ufispace.com and distributor pages (stordis.com). Hence lifecycle eol none-announced.","grounding":"photo + HIG - the rear-left plate carries two M4 grounding holes with the earth symbol below (HIG Figure 24 shows the lug and screws landing exactly there; positions photo-measured at (6.3, 7.9) and (6.3, 23.1), symbol centre (6.3, 35.5)). The HIG names a second designated location on the side of the switch under a yellow 'REMOVE LABEL FOR SYSTEM GROUNDING' label (Figure 23); it is drawn on the left face near the rear as a yellow decor rect, position estimated from the isometric figure.","layout-x":"drawing - the HIG port-overview faceplate figure (fig-0020, 1474 px wide, read at 3.350 px/mm against the 440 mm width). Its aspect is 9.70 against a true 10.05 (3.5% squashed vertically), so per Gate 1 only x-fractions were taken from it. Measured on the two SFP+ blocks' silver mid-strips: block 1 x 26.3-197.0, block 2 x 200.3-371.0 - each 170.7 mm for 12 columns, which is the std/sfp-ganged 14.25 mm pitch to 0.2%, so the columns are laid at exactly 14.25 (block 1 from 26.3, block 2 from 200.4, 3.1 mm inter-block gap). QSFP28 block measured x 375.2-432.2; modelled as three 18.5 mm std/qsfp-ganged columns on a 19.0 pitch from 375.4. Management bezel measured x 6.3-23.0.","layout-y":"photo-measured - the straight-on front photograph (s7801-54xs-2-front.png, 51 px of face height for 43.8 mm, so coarse at 0.86 mm/px; the schematic figure is 3.5% wrong in y and was not used for this axis). Photo puts the top cage flange at ~8.6-9.5, the inter-row strip at ~19-25, and the blue numbering band at ~34.4-38.7. Modelled with the standard cage heights: SFP+ rows at y 9.0 and 24.4 (10.4 tall), silver strip 19.4-24.4, number bands 35.2-38.4; QSFP28 rows at 9.42 and 25.2 (9.58 tall). Row positions are photo-anchored, cage heights are registry values.","led-semantics":"HIG section 10 (pages 21-22), transcribed onto the placements rather than only cited: the SYS/FAN/PS0/PS1/ID tables onto the five status lamps, the Management Port LED table onto the OOB jack's two elements (left lamp green 1G link/activity, right lamp amber 10/100M link/activity - the two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so states are per element). The PSU FRU and Fan FRU tables belong to the modules and are already transcribed in ufispace/psu-401-* and ufispace/fan-402825. The HIG gives NO table for the SFP+ arrow lamps or the QSFP28 lane lamps, so those keep their component default of off/on - see gaps.","mgmt-stack":"photo - the left-end management column, top to bottom: OOB RJ45 with integrated lamps (network-tree symbol printed above), blue USB 3.0 Type-A, RJ45 serial console (legend 'SS/arrows/IOIOI' printed below), all on a light bezel plate measured x 6.3-23.0 in the faceplate figure. Vertical positions estimated to fit the photographed stack into the 43.8 face using the components' own contract heights (14.9 + 9.3 + 12.5); the photo shows the jacks nearly touching, as modelled. Both RJ45s are keyway-down in the zoomed angle photograph (s7801-54xs-1-view.png), so neither is rotated. The console is common/rj45-shielded (no lamps), which draws its contacts at the top and matches the photo; the OOB is common/rj45-port whose lamp pair matches the photographed green corner lamps. CAVEAT, checked in a zoomed crop per the gate: the photographed OOB jack is keyway-down, so its contacts face UP, while common/rj45-port draws lamps-top/contacts-DOWN and cannot show both; rotating it would put the lamps at the bottom, a larger error than the contact side, so it is placed unrotated. The S9510-28DC uses the same component the same way.","part-numbers":"FRU part numbers are the datasheet's own ordering list (PSU-401-DESR / PSU-401-AESR exhaust, PSU-401-DISB-1 / PSU-401-AISB intake, FAN-402825-CD intake / FAN-402825-HD exhaust; exhaust FRUs pair with front-to-back system airflow and red latches, intake with back-to-front and blue, per HIG sections 4 and the airflow caution). NO orderable chassis SKU appears in either document - after the S9510-28DC lesson this is recorded as a statement about these two documents, not about the world; see gaps. Configuration FRU models are set per configuration via component-attrs.","port-leds":"photo - each SFP+ column carries one up/down triangle-lamp pair on the silver inter-row strip (up = even/top port, down = odd/bottom port), matching the S9510-28DC arrangement, so common/led-arrow is reused at the same in-column offsets. Each QSFP28 port carries four lane lamps: the top-row ports' four sit in the perforated row above the block (y 6.6), the bottom-row ports' four below the olive band (y 38.9), confirmed by counting dots in the zoomed angle photograph (4 per column above and below). Modelled as four common/led-dot per port rather than common/qsfp-lane-leds because that strip is 19.5 mm wide and would collide on this 19.0 mm column pitch.","port-numbers":"photo - the real device prints port numbers only on the coloured bands under each block (steel-blue for SFP+ '\u25b20 1\u25bc' pairs, olive for QSFP28 '\u25b248 49\u25bc' pairs; up-arrow names the top-row port, down-arrow the bottom). The HIG figure additionally paints large numerals on the cage faces, but the photographs show open dark cages with no numerals - guide art is a mock-up, the real device wins, so the big numerals are not drawn. Band colours sampled from the photographs (#6b9cbd blue, #4a5441 olive).","power":"datasheet - 'Typical power: 111.3 Watts (no transceiver)' is explicitly a bare-optics figure, hence power-envelope: bare. HIG Connecting Power section (both DC and AC versions) - 'The maximum system power consumption is 203.3 watts'; the vendor does not qualify what population that maximum assumes, so per the capture rule it is filed as power-max-w with this sentence as the record that the qualifier is the vendor's silence, not a measurement scope we chose. Inputs: AC 100-240 V 6 A, DC -36 to -75 V 16 A (datasheet Power Specs; HIG repeats both and adds the per-PSU fuse ratings 12 A AC / 20 A DC and the 5000 m power-source altitude rating).","rear-layout":"photo-measured - straight-on rear photograph (s7801-54xs-3-rear.png, 1568 px for the 440 mm face, 3.56 px/mm). Fan handles repeat on a 52.5 mm pitch; the 51.5 mm bays (HIG fan module 51.5 x 57.8 x 42.2) are laid from x 14.7, matching the photographed module edges to ~1 px. PSU bays (HIG PSU 50.5 x 211 x 40) at x 322.3 and 381.9, read from the handle and divider edges; each PSU's vertical 'PSU0/PSU1' legend with a left-pointing triangle sits on the chassis strip to its right (376.6 and 435.8). Order left to right: FAN 0-4, PSU0, PSU1. The 'FAN N' legends with left-pointing triangles are printed at the top-right of each fan opening; like the S9510-28DC's they render under the seated module and show only with the bay empty. The red 'E' (exhaust) badge and airflow-colour handle are properties of the FRU face, not the chassis, and the existing fan/PSU skins do not draw the badge - noted, not modelled. The psu-401 skins were drawn from the S9510-28DC's blue-latch intake variants, so in the front-to-back configurations the rendered latch colour is blue where the photographed DESR/AESR units have red latches; one skin per component, noted rather than redrawn.","sides":"estimated - HIG Figure 13 (rack-bracket positions) shows both sides as rows of screw/rivet heads on two lines with bracket hole clusters at the front, rear and a middle position 220.5 mm from the front face. Rivet positions are estimated off that figure; only count and the two-row arrangement were taken. AXIS CONVENTION: on the LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR; on the RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT (renderer convention). The yellow grounding label sits on the left face near the rear, i.e. at small x in the left view.","sources":"datasheet (working/intake/ufispace/datacenter/s7801-54xs-datasheet.pdf, docling-converted) for dimensions, weight, port counts, power, platform and compliance; hardware installation guide (s7801-54xs-hig.pdf, same directory) for the component physical table, FRU part numbers, LED tables and the port overview figure (Figure 11 / fig-0020); four photographs (working/intake/ufispace/photos/s7801-54xs-*) for colour, counts, orientation and the rear layout. FRU components ufispace/psu-401-ac, psu-401-dc and fan-402825 already existed from the S9510-28DC (same FRU family, same part numbers, HIG dimensions identical) and are reused, not rebuilt.","system-leds":"drawing - lamp x positions read off the faceplate figure at 3.35 px/mm (SYS 52.4, FAN 59.2, PS0 66.0, PS1 72.8, ID below PS1), arrangement confirmed by HIG Figure 28 (SYS FAN PS0 PS1 in a row, ID on a second row under PS1). The real lamps are ~2.4 x 1.2 mm rounded rectangles; modelled as common/led-dot (2 mm round) because no 2.4 mm rect lamp component exists and led-rect at 4.6 mm would not fit the 6.8 mm label pitch.","top":"estimated from HIG Figure 5 (top view, dimensioned 440 x 440) and the datasheet's angled render: four pressed stiffening grooves (the upper two, nearer the rear, start right of centre; the lower two run most of the width) and screw heads along the rear and front edges. Groove and screw positions are estimated - the figure is a photograph-like view with no internal dimensions. AXIS CONVENTION: y = 0 is the REAR edge, per the house top-view rule; the grooves are nearer the front, so they sit at large y. Content is symmetric left-right except the groove stagger, which was checked against the angled photo (short grooves toward the rear)."},"references":[{"sha256":"d46581f3de9b78f465ba06c2bc4116876c042a55504b889c65d34f61303cfc8f","title":"UfiSpace S7801-54XS Hardware Installation Guide"}],"version":"0.1.0","views":{"bottom":{"components":{"placements":[{"at":[110.0,110.0],"group":"furniture","id":"bottom-label","ref":"common/compliance-sticker@1","rel-pos":7}]},"size":{"h":440,"w":440}},"front":{"components":{"placements":[{"at":[6.2,4.4],"attrs":{"role":"mgmt","speed":"100m-1g"},"description":"HIG Management Port LED table - left lamp Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); right lamp Off, Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table - left lamp Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); right lamp Off, Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so states are per element
g.title: mgmt-oob

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (fans not initialized), Solid Green (all fans work normal), Blinking Amber (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: every indicator that belongs to a particular port, ordered by that port
